name: Dual-Cursed Oracle
summary: All oracles are cursed to some degree, but some oracles bear an even heavier burden.
replacesText: Oracle’s Curse; Mystery Class Skills; Mystery Bonus Spells

features.name: Progressing Curse
features.summary: Choose the curse that advances normally with your oracle levels.

features.name: Non-progressing Curse
features.summary: Choose a different curse. It keeps only its 1st-level effects as you advance.

features.name: Class Skills
features.summary: A dual-cursed oracle gains no additional class skills from her mystery.

features.name: Bonus Spells
features.summary: ill omen (2nd), oracle’s burden (4th), bestow curse (6th). These bonus spells replace the oracle’s mystery bonus spells at these levels.

features.name: Revelation
features.summary: Choose another revelation from your mystery or the dual-cursed revelations.

features.name: Revelation
features.summary: Choose another revelation from your mystery or the dual-cursed revelations.

features.name: Misfortune (Ex)
features.summary: As an immediate action, force a creature within 30 feet to reroll a d20 before its result is revealed. It uses the new roll even if it is worse and cannot be targeted again for one day.

resourceActions.label: Force a d20 reroll with Misfortune

confirmations.label: The creature is within 30 feet, its result is unrevealed, and Misfortune has not affected it today

resourceActions.summary: Roll a new d20 for the creature and use that result.

features.name: Fortune (Ex)
features.summary: Reroll one of your d20 rolls as an immediate action before the result is revealed. Use the new roll even if it is worse. You can use Fortune once daily at 5th level and gain another use at 11th and 17th level.

resourceActions.label: Reroll a d20 with Fortune

confirmations.label: The result of my roll has not been revealed

resourceActions.summary: Use the new d20 result even if it is lower.

featureOverrides.summary: Choose a mystery for its remaining bonus spells, revelations, and final revelation. Your mystery supplies no additional class skills.

mechanicalNotes: Curse choices, replacement spells, added revelations, Fortune uses, and both rerolls are available. Track the two curses’ individual effects and each creature’s daily Misfortune eligibility at the table.
